about_the_game:
Welcome to Turning Manor! Your job is simple: 

  • Count the glitches

  • Choose the correct door

But this won't be as easy as it seems...

Key Features

  • Unlock unique areas. Each area provides a distinct experience with different layouts, themes, dangers, things to track and secrets to uncover.

  • Easy to pick up. Not used to this type of work? No problem! Progress will not reset and only the correct door is needed to move forward.

  • Yet hard to master... Already an expert? Accuracy matters for your grade and glitch difficulty increases at the end of runs for an extra challenge.

  • Mystery to unravel. What is going on at the Manor? Explore to collect items for clues and fill collections to uncover the secrets of the Manor’s inhabitants.

Turning Manor is a horror first person spot the difference puzzle game that takes around 2 hours to complete.

Developer Note

No part of this game knowingly uses AI generated content or images. Though many industry standard programs incorporate AI into their workflow and we can’t guarantee externally created assets are not AI generated, Sabbatical Games tries to minimize the impact on our final content by using a combination of hand crafted, photo scanned and creative commons assets.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: intel 8700
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX-1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: intel 8700
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX-2000 series, or RX 6000 series
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A horror first person spot the difference puzzle game. The job is simple: count the differences and choose an exit. Yet it wont be so easy... Explore and uncover the mysteries of Turning Manor.
